event.title: MOCK · Sildar freed by agreement
event.detail: In the mock campaign: after Klarg was wounded, the party accepted his departure with his wolf instead of executing him. Yeemik released Sildar under the negotiated bargain and retained the hideout. Donavan interpreted the Goblin conversation. Stolen supplies were recovered for review in Phandalin; no payments granted yet.
